    while (x > 0) {

        ++cnt;
    }
    return cnt;

llong construct(llong x) {
    int digits = countDigits(x);

    for (int i = 0; i < digits; ++i) {
        cur += base;
        base *= 10;
    }

    return (cur - 1) / 10;

llong solve(llong x) {
    if (x <= 6) return x;
    if (x <= 11) return 13 - x;
    
    llong base = construct(x);
    llong nextRep = base * 10 + 1;

    int cnt = 0;
    do {
        ++cnt;
        x /= 10;
    } while (x != 0);
    return cnt;
}

llong make_rep(llong n) {
    llong val = 0;
    llong mult = 1;
    llong t = n;
    while (t) {
        val += mult;
        mult *= 10;
        t /= 10;
    }
    if (val <= n) return val;
    return (val - 1) / 10;
}

llong calc(llong n) {
    if (n <= 6) return n;
    if (n <= 11) return 13 - n;
    
    llong r = make_rep(n);
    llong next_r = r * 10 + 1;
    
    if (n % r == 0) {
        llong k = n / r;
        if (n <= next_r / 2 + r) {
            return digit_num(r) * k;
        } else {
            return digit_num(next_r) + calc(next_r - n);
        }
    } else {
        llong lo = (n / r) * r;
        llong hi = lo + r;
        llong ans = calc(lo) + calc(n - lo);
        if (n > next_r / 2) {
